topic: Interior Lighting Sub System - Door Rear Right Lamp Fade Speed Command
row_semantics: Each row represents a different fade speed rate for the rear right door lamp, defined by its duration (e.g., 1s, 2s) and associated breathing mode.

column_semantics.Column2: Duration of the Fade Cycle in Seconds
column_semantics.Column3: Associated Breathing Mode (e.g., Original Breathing Mode 2)

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the parameters for controlling the fade speed and breathing modes of the rear right door lamp in the Interior Lighting Sub System. It specifies how different commands map to specific fade durations and breathing patterns, which can be used to verify that the lamp responds correctly to various input signals from the Body Control Module over the LIN network.
